approaches.hypothesis: A hash-bound supersession chain preserves the atom's full surface across fresh immutable runs.
approaches.implementation: Record a verified predecessor chain at start and copy its earliest baseline into the successor run.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Adds one explicit start flag and one immutable sidecar while keeping ordinary starts unchanged.

approaches.hypothesis: The existing fresh-start contract is sufficient if operators order edits after the final rebuild.
approaches.implementation: Keep capturing the current tree on every start and rely on operators to delay canonical edits.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: No controller change, but the correct edit order remains outside code and rebuilds can erase the surface.
